Name: Back to the Valley - A Seasons Themed Music Mod
Author: JaredAlexanderJohnson
Description:
[size=6][b]Welcome to Back to the Valley!
[/b][/size]This mod is an overhaul of my previous mod, To the Valley. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/kJ9rV0Z/back-to-the-valley-cover-1.png[/img]

[size=6][b]Back to the Valley features 12 songs that replace the existing exploration music over the various seasons with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url]! [/b][/size]
[size=3]All music was composed and recorded faithfully in the style of the Stardew Valley OST using the same samples and plugins.  [/size]

[size=5][b]What it sounds like:[/b][/size]

[youtube]sfETZRv225Q[/youtube]
[youtube]Cjtq6BBikIA[/youtube]
[youtube]R3kXRgr7Yfk[/youtube]
[youtube]L-m9qjLM6-Q[/youtube]

[size=6][img]https://i.ibb.co/MVjfsc4/back-to-the-valley-panel-2.png[/img][/size]
[size=6][b]All music is free to use for modders and content creators![/b][/size]
[size=3]It can be difficult to find music for mods, especially if you're making custom areas for the game. That's why I'm making all music available for your projects to help make your worlds feel more alive. 

You can download high quality .wav files of all the music [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11498]here![/url]
[/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/PtxTcm2/back-to-the-valley-modders.png[/img]
[size=6][b]My music is available to stream on [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/4jZkQRRaipZ2KwstrGylyL?si=exGuzb7NSISoXT_MKGWmWw]Spotify[/url][/b][/size]
[size=3]You can stream the music from To the Valley, Back to the Valley, as well as all my other mods on Spotify. 
[/size]All revenue goes directly to the NAACP. I do not make a profit from any of this, I just enjoy writing music and making mods. 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/YkFNyJ7/back-to-the-valley-stream.png[/img]

[b][size=5]﻿Follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/JA_Johnson_]Twitter[/url] to keep up with my music (and my shenanigans) [/size][/b]
